verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server or endpoint for connecting agents. The llms.txt file, REST API, SDKs and webhooks are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
